title: Electroporation for Cancer Treatment Real World Registry
official: Electroporation for Cancer Treatment Real World Registry
summary: This registry aims to assess real-world long-term disease outcomes for patients treated using reversible electroporation and a chemotherapeutic or calcium; in particular tumour response rates and recurrence rates. The study also aims to characterise side effects and the occurrence of Adverse Events and their relationship to the treatment.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any patient who has been treated using Calcium Electroporation
* Any patient who has been treated using Electrochemotherapy
* Patients must be mentally capable of understanding the information given
* Patients must give written informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
